assumptions: The unit roundoff u is nonnegative.
The local estimates obtained from Lemmas 4.1 and 4.3 hold on the computed upper triangle.

formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p05_t3_cholesky_backward_error {n : Nat} ... : exists DeltaA, R^T R=A+DeltaA and |DeltaA_ij| <= (i+1)*u*(|R^T||R|)_ij and |DeltaA_ij| <= (n+1)*u*(|R^T||R|)_ij
formal_statement.plain_language: The upper-triangle Cholesky residual estimates extend by symmetry to the full displayed rowwise bound and its uniform (n+1)u consequence.

informal_proof: Show that R^T R and |R^T||R| are symmetric. Use the upper-triangle estimate directly when i<=j and its transposed copy otherwise, loosen the smaller row factor, then use i+1<=n+1.
informal_statement: The symmetry completion and two componentwise estimates in Theorem 4.4 and equation (4.4).
